patroni_conf_path.description: Path to the Patroni configuration file (YAML)

patroni_logfile_path.description: Path to the Patroni log file

patroni_postgres_version.description: Explicit PostgreSQL version to use for PGPATH (e.g. '14'). Leave empty to auto-detect via postgresql-common.

patroni_version.description: PostgreSQL major version (e.g. '14', '15') used in scope, paths, and log filenames.

patroni_cluster.description: Patroni cluster name (scope name) used in scope, paths, and log filenames.

patroni_hostname.description: Hostname of this Patroni node, used as the cluster member name.

patroni_dcs_config.default: # DCS configuration (etcd, zookeeper, consul, etc.) goes here
patroni_dcs_config.description: Configuration block for the Distributed Configuration Store (DCS). Leave as comment if not needed for default standalone test.

patroni_hostip.description: IP address of this node for API and PostgreSQL connections.

patroni_api_port.description: Port for the Patroni REST API.

patroni_listen_vip.description: Virtual IP address to listen on if required (e.g. ',192.168.1.10'). Leave empty for default wildcard listen.

patroni_datadir_base.description: Base directory for PostgreSQL data directories.

patroni_network.description: Network CIDR for pg_hba.conf replication and application access.
